# GAMMA Character Selector

A character creator for the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Anomaly modpack G.A.M.M.A. On the
New Game screen you choose a gender, a portrait from that gender's faction pool
and a generated name, and the character keeps that look, voice, movement
sounds, health-HUD silhouette, portrait and dialogue wording for that life,
across saves and loads; an Azazel possession adopts the possessed NPC's
identity.

- **Male** is built in and uses GAMMA's own files at their stock paths.
- **Gender packs:** other genders come from separate pack mods.
- **Last settings:** New Game remembers every choice you made on it last time
  (name, faction, gender, portrait, starting location, difficulties, loadout
  and game modes) and restores them the next time it opens, even after a
  restart.
- **Presets:** 24 named preset slots for setups you want to keep. They replace
  New Game Templates, whose saved presets are still read.
- **Custom genders** are plain config files; no Lua is needed.

## Download

Download the `.7z` from
[Releases](https://github.com/Q4ln/GAMMA-Character-Selector/releases/latest)
and install it with Mod Organizer 2's **Install Mod** button.

## Documentation

Requirements, installation order, options, saves, known issues, the changelog
and credits are in
[GAMMA Character Selector - README.md](https://github.com/Q4ln/GAMMA-Character-Selector/blob/main/GAMMA%20Character%20Selector%20-%20README.md),
which also ships inside the archive.

Apart from this page, the repository holds exactly the files the release
archive installs.
